name: M7.RecipeSignature.signature_properties
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ c : M7.Action.Recipe N, (M7.RecipeSignature.signature c).Monic ∧ M7.RecipeSignature.signature c ∣ (M6.Cyclic.modulus N)
guidance: Literal signature_divides gives divisibility into nonzero monic modulus. Therefore signature is nonzero, and accepted SignatureTau.binary_monic applies. No weight/connectedness/odd-N premise is needed. Return tactic lines without leading by.
